description: Change one task: add a note for its agent (they are woken with it), raise its priority to high, record that it waits on another task (blocked_by) or no longer does (unblock), or close it as cancelled with a reason. Tasks are never deleted. tasks_get shows the result.

blocked_by.description: A task this one must wait for, e.g. DIVE-120.

cancel.description: Close the task as cancelled; the reason, in one or two sentences.

note.description: Feedback or instructions for the task's agent.

priority.description: Raise the task to high. Lowering is the user's call.

unblock.description: A task this one no longer waits for.

name: tasks_update
